name: datakeel_file_discovery_delete
sql: CREATE TRIGGER datakeel_file_discovery_delete AFTER DELETE ON versions BEGIN DELETE FROM file_discovery WHERE version_id = OLD.id; END

name: datakeel_file_discovery_insert
sql: CREATE TRIGGER datakeel_file_discovery_insert AFTER INSERT ON versions BEGIN INSERT INTO file_discovery (file_id, name, dataset_id, version_id, created_at) SELECT file_id, name, dataset_id, version_id, created_at FROM (SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY file_id ORDER BY ordinal) AS priority FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_extract(j.value, '$.id' ) END AS file_id, CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_extract(j.value, '$.filename' ) END AS name, NEW.dataset_id AS dataset_id, NEW.id AS version_id, NEW.created_at AS created_at, CAST(j.key AS INTEGER) AS ordinal FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.manifest) THEN CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.manifest) = 'array' THEN NEW.manifest ELSE '[]' END ELSE '[]' END) AS j WHERE CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_type(j.value, '$.id' ) = 'text' AND json_type(j.value, '$.filename' ) = 'text' ELSE 0 END AND NEW.created_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM datasets WHERE id = NEW.dataset_id)) AS c) AS ranked WHERE priority = 1; END

name: datakeel_file_discovery_update
sql: CREATE TRIGGER datakeel_file_discovery_update AFTER UPDATE ON versions BEGIN DELETE FROM file_discovery WHERE version_id IN (OLD.id, NEW.id); INSERT INTO file_discovery (file_id, name, dataset_id, version_id, created_at) SELECT file_id, name, dataset_id, version_id, created_at FROM (SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY file_id ORDER BY ordinal) AS priority FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_extract(j.value, '$.id' ) END AS file_id, CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_extract(j.value, '$.filename' ) END AS name, NEW.dataset_id AS dataset_id, NEW.id AS version_id, NEW.created_at AS created_at, CAST(j.key AS INTEGER) AS ordinal FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(NEW.manifest) THEN CASE WHEN json_type(NEW.manifest) = 'array' THEN NEW.manifest ELSE '[]' END ELSE '[]' END) AS j WHERE CASE WHEN j.type = 'object' THEN json_type(j.value, '$.id' ) = 'text' AND json_type(j.value, '$.filename' ) = 'text' ELSE 0 END AND NEW.created_at IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM datasets WHERE id = NEW.dataset_id)) AS c) AS ranked WHERE priority = 1; END

name: datakeel_file_python_datasets_insert
sql: CREATE TRIGGER datakeel_file_python_datasets_insert AFTER INSERT ON datasets BEGIN INSERT INTO file_discovery_checkpoints (generation) SELECT 'public-files-python-json-v1' WHERE (lower(CAST(NEW.files AS TEXT)) GLOB ( '*' || char(92) || 'u0000*' ) OR lower(CAST(NEW.files AS TEXT)) GLOB ( '*' || char(92) || 'ud[89abcdef]*' )) ON CONFLICT(generation) DO NOTHING; END
